questions.question: According to a wise saying, what should you do so your plans will be achieved?

answers.text: Commit your works to the LORD
Hide your plans from your enemies

questions.question: What does a proverb say about everyone who is proud in heart?

answers.text: They will be given more time
They will learn on their own

questions.question: A proverb says the lot is cast into the lap. Who makes its every decision?
According to a proverb, how does someone turn aside from evil?

answers.text: By the fear of the LORD
By the counsel of the elders
By the strength of his hand
